text.card: A star about 140 parsecs away, 10 times the Sun's width, measured by Gaia.
text.introduction: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 10.1 solar radii and 2.80 solar masses (FLAME) and 4,939 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).

quotes.title: HD 145457
quotes.card: HD 145457 is a star located in the northern constellation of Corona Borealis at a distance of around 442 light-years from the Sun, as determined through parallax measurements.
quotes.introduction: It has been formally named Kamuy by the IAU, after a spiritual or divine being in Ainu mythology.
